# KINECT

KINECT is client portal software for agencies, coaches and consultants: a
branded portal your clients actually open, with analytics and AI that
explains the work sitting right next to it.

## Persona sites

- https://agency.kinectnow.com/ - Client portal, campaign analytics and AI
  reporting for marketing and creative agencies.
- https://coach.kinectnow.com/ - Program delivery, check-ins and progress
  proof for fitness coaches and trainers.
- https://consultant.kinectnow.com/ - Engagements, deliverables and
  billable hours for consultants and advisors.

## Pricing

Flat monthly pricing, no per-seat fees: Starter $149, Growth $399, Scale
$799.

## Status

KINECT is pre-launch. The waitlist is open at https://kinectnow.com/; the
product itself is not yet publicly available.
